name: Infantry_Scripting
author: Infantry AI
description: Owns the open script-engine extension point: engine plugins publish under scripting.engine/, this plugin finds them and holds the run limits.

tools.name: infantry_script_run
tools.description: Run a named project script as the caller (the daemon runs its queued tool calls), or plan it with dryRun.

tools.name: infantry_script_api
tools.description: Every tool a script can call (live registry), the alias table and the engine bindings.

tools.name: infantry_chat_note
tools.description: Post a status line into a session's chat (no turn, no mail unless wake=true).

tools.name: infantry_session_read
tools.description: Read a session's state, current tool, last output time and its last chat lines (capped).

tools.name: infantry_session_act
tools.description: Interrupt or end the turn of a session in flight.

tools.name: infantry_notice_suppress
tools.description: Mark a built-in daemon notice as suppressed for a while so a hook can replace it.

tools.name: infantry_script_hook
tools.description: List, add or remove the project's script hooks (lane enter / named event -> stored script).

tools.name: infantry_script_save
tools.description: Save a project script (parse-checked) so infantry_script_run and infantry_script_hook can use it at once.

tools.name: infantry_script_list
tools.description: The project's stored scripts: engine, size, modified time, who saved them, hooks using them.

tools.name: infantry_script_delete
tools.description: Delete a stored script; refused while a hook uses it.

tools.name: infantry_exec
tools.description: Run a command line as the caller (no shell); exit code and output tails back. Off until scripting.exec.enabled.

tools.name: infantry_exec_status
tools.description: State and result of a background infantry_exec run.

tools.name: infantry_script_stats
tools.description: Script automation, read-only: turns saved, wakes by reason and the latest script runs.

fields.label: Default engine id
Max steps per run
Timeout per run (ms)
Max allocation per run (bytes)
Max re-runs per script (ih.again)
Script aliases (JSON: short name to tool name)
Run script hooks on events
Mail hook failures to the hook owner (off: activity log and ticket comment only)
Hook loop guard: max chain depth
Hook loop guard: max runs per hook per window
Hook loop guard: rate window (ms)
Hook loop guard: attribute follow-up events within (ms)
Process bridge: let scripts and agents run command lines (infantry_exec)
Process bridge allow-list (JSON array or one per line; prefix, or re:<regex> for the whole line; empty = all)
Process bridge roles (comma-separated; empty = any role)
Process bridge default timeout (s)
Process bridge max timeout (s)
Process bridge output tail (chars)
Timer hooks (every <N>s): minimum period (s)
Process bridge: seconds between exec.tick events for a background run
Shipped hooks turned off (comma-separated ids, e.g. resume-after-restart; bind your own script to the event instead)
After a daemon restart, prompt each session whose turn it cut to continue (shipped hook resume-after-restart; its starter and the owner are told either way)
The prompt a cut session gets after a restart (empty = the script's default)
